note: agy g1 (Vite) and g2 (Next) drove real browsers on the local Docker stack (main e3711853, one PR older than baseline b77e9fd2) as Tom, Sara, Lina, Grace and Zoe, desktop 1440x900 and phone 390x844. The orchestrator checked every claim against its screenshot and script. Dropped as not product defects: sign-up blocked by the fake local reCAPTCHA key (environment only); /signup 404 (the real route is /register and nothing links to /signup). Corrected: 'Apply Now fails silently' (P0) -> a role-mismatch error toast is shown (P2 U1); 'marketplace listing dead end' (P1) -> a deliberate prerequisites gate (P2 U2). Positive evidence: Lina and Grace saw only their own pharmacies and URL id tampering did not open another pharmacy.

findings.title: The public shift board offers Apply Now on shifts for a role the worker cannot take, then shows only a vague failure toast.
findings.scenario: Sara is a pharmacist. On the public shift board she sees Apply Now on Tom's technician shift and taps it. She gets 'Failed to express interest in this shift.' with no reason, so she may think the site is broken or retry.
findings.test_needed: Log in as a pharmacist, open a technician shift on the public board: the button should be hidden/disabled with the reason, or the error should name the role mismatch.

owner_question.question: Sara (pharmacist) sees Tom's technician shift on the public board. What should she see?
options: Hide shifts for roles she cannot take
Show them but disable Apply with 'For technicians only'
Keep today: Apply Now, then a generic error

findings.title: The marketplace listing gate lists 'Verify your mobile number' with no way to do it, and the 8-step bar is cut off at desktop width.
findings.scenario: Tom opens Add item in the marketplace. He is told to verify his mobile number, complete identity checks and accept terms. Only the identity row has a link, so Tom does not know where to verify his mobile. The step bar's last label is cut off ('Save draf').
findings.test_needed: Open /marketplace/new as an owner without a verified mobile: each unmet prerequisite should link to where it is completed; step labels fit at 1440px.

findings.title: Several phone tap targets are below 44px (public job board map/report buttons, talent board nav links, landing role pills, dashboard top-bar icons).
findings.scenario: Sara browses shifts on her phone and keeps missing the small 'Show map' and 'Report' buttons; Tom misses the 38px top-bar icons on his dashboard.
findings.test_needed: Measure the named controls at 390px width: each tappable box should be at least 44x44px.

findings.title: Ethical marketplace sub-pages keep the generic landing page title, so browser tabs and history cannot be told apart.
findings.scenario: Tom has inventory, listings and transfers open in three tabs; all three tabs show the same generic title.
findings.test_needed: Open /marketplace/ethical/inventory, /listings, /transfers: each should set its own document title.

findings.title: On phone, tapping the 'I agree to the Terms' label may open the terms link instead of ticking the box, leaving Register disabled.
findings.scenario: Zoe signs up on her phone. She taps the 'I agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy' text to tick it; a terms page opens instead and the box stays unticked, so Register stays greyed out.
findings.test_needed: At 390px on /register, tap the label text outside the link words: the checkbox should toggle; only the link words open the policy.

findings.title: Typing a date (DD/MM/YYYY) in the post-shift date field is rejected with 'Pick a date first'; only the picker works.
findings.scenario: Tom types 27/10/2026 into the shift date box and presses Add date; he gets 'Pick a date first' and has to reopen the picker for each date of a multi-date shift.
findings.test_needed: Type a valid DD/MM/YYYY date and press Add date: it should be added.

findings.title: If the API cannot be reached at start-up, the web app shows an unstyled error with run-together buttons; Reconnect reloads into the same state and Retry logout has no way out.
findings.scenario: Omar opens the app during a backend outage or on bad Wi-Fi. He sees plain text and 'ReconnectRetry logout' run together; Reconnect reloads into the same page and logout fails, so he is stuck with no explanation.
findings.test_needed: Start the web app with the API unreachable: the error screen should be styled, buttons separated and at least 44px, and offer a working way back (e.g. to /login).

findings.title: Workers can clock in only with the counter QR or kiosk PIN; there is no manual fallback when both are unavailable.
findings.scenario: Sara arrives for Tom's shift but the counter QR is missing and the kiosk tablet is off. The app offers no other way to record her start time, so her timesheet starts late or empty.
findings.test_needed: Product decision first; then a test for the chosen fallback.

owner_question.question: Sara is at Tom's pharmacy but the QR code and the kiosk are both unavailable. What should happen?
options: She requests a manual clock-in that Tom approves
Tom records her times afterwards in attendance review
Keep today: no fallback; fix in the timesheet
